scope: Three original dungeon PSD windows with native server and Unity actions; Kazamata leaderboard page only

implementation.information: Live Lua catalog (19 dungeons), level/team/duration/cooldown/entry item information, personal completion/best time/max hit, server clock countdown, available filter, scrollable selection, confirmed server-resolved entrance teleport
implementation.recruitment: Current-core online eligible leaders/solo applicants; 32 advertised players, five-minute TTL; real native party invitation/request with recipient consent
implementation.leaderboard: Only Kazamata page. Per dungeon UTC Monday weekly ranking by completed runs, fastest elapsed or highest real hit; top 100 and own placement; deterministic ties, GM/blocked account exclusion; no difficulty or point currency
implementation.result: Production quest/native controller completion hooks. Server-owned elapsed, deaths, kills, actual HP damage/healing/taken, accepted XP, net Yang balance change, confirmed typed loot, personal record and visual grade. Team/member and loot paging; clipboard share, exit and leader-validated same-party return to entrance
implementation.persistence: Transactional InnoDB run/member/loot tables, UTC DATETIME(3), participant-owned result reads, parameterized queries, 64-bit metrics, late asynchronous loot attribution by captured random server run ID
implementation.layout: Original native Photoshop artwork. Right-docked compact proportional layout, desktop/touch readable type floors, scrolling for overflow, minimum click areas, reachable header/floating close controls
implementation.routing: Private instances stay on their hosting core. Dungeon entrance/retry prefers the current core when that map is locally loaded, preserving real party membership; normal routing remains available otherwise
implementation.entrypoint: ESC or bottom-right gear -> Kazamaták. Reuses the PSD menu button released by combining system/game settings. No separate dungeon hotkey.
